specs.name: 泡泡
specs.prompt:
Generate a NEW fully composed SINGLE-character illustrated design sheet for the Chinese game 《交子赶工记》. Landscape 16:9, generously high resolution. Reference 1 is PRIMARY for hand-drawn graphic ink quality and editorial character-sheet composition, NOT its human character. Reference 2 is secondary for the animal-world identity and red-panda anatomy, NOT its old name, stamp specialty, polished shading, or soft 3D-like finish. Only the requested animal appears, repeated as model sheet poses. No human character.

ART DIRECTION: Strongly visibly hand drawn Chinese animation development art on warm off-white paper. Confident expressive black-brown brush contours with extreme thick-thin variations, occasional dry-brush gaps and doubled searching lines; visible decisive brush starts and tapering ends; sparse colored pencil construction accents in expressive poses. Flat, opaque gouache paint blocked with uneven bristle edges and slight deliberate registration offsets. Deliberately simplified large color shapes, maximum two tonal shapes per form, restrained hatch accents rather than volumetric gradients. More lively, graphic and personally drawn than reference 2. Natural asymmetry in brows, stance and clothes, silhouette reads from far away. No plastic lighting, no plush/furry 3D rendering, no vector-perfect contours, no smooth airbrush, no excessive speckled noise overlay, no dense decorative texture, no cluttered clothing detail. Strong vivid local color on animal and clothing, keep cream paper quiet; do NOT desaturate the whole image. Cute highly stylized big head, short body, credible animal paws and expressive distinct silhouette.

COMPOSITION: Closely adapt reference 1's whole-page organization. Thin uneven hand-painted vermilion double border with tiny simple corner motifs; left narrow column exactly 3 distinctly expressive head studies, central-left one large full-body hero drawing from ears to toes and tail, right upper area clean Chinese name and short personality introduction, a modest compact relevant prop vignette, lower-right exactly 3 separated funny storytelling action vignettes of the same character with very different gestures. A few economical hand-drawn annotation arrows and motion lines, ample breathing room, NOT a rigid tiled infographic, NOT four characters squeezed into one board. All repeated views must have consistent proportions, clothing, tail, facial features. Keep the body lively and performative, with strong line of action, balanced feet. No extra limbs, no disconnected paws, no intersecting props. Production character design art, not a game UI screen.

TYPOGRAPHY: crisp correctly formed hand-lettered Chinese. Text supplied below must be accurate; short readable labels only, no invented long paragraphs or random pseudo-text. Do not print '阿绒', '金豆', '墨墨', '沐沐', '掌印钱灵', or any human character name. No watermarks, no artist signature. Tools are fixed workstation tools in gameplay; show relevant prop designs separately. Every action shows at most ONE carried paper sheet, never a stack of carried sheets.
SUBJECT: 泡泡, a female upright OTTER artisan. A low compact bean / water-droplet body, broad soft rounded muzzle, tiny rounded ears tucked close to head, very short facial whiskers, long strong gently tapered otter tail flowing low behind. Not a beaver: no flat paddle tail and no big buck teeth. Spirited bright eyes, one lively lifted eyebrow, small indigo cloth knot near one ear, not a human hairstyle. Rich warm umber fur and cream muzzle, indigo rolled-sleeve crossover work robe, teal waist tie, small warm ochre trim, exposed dark animal paws. Minimal, readable garment design. Around 2.6 heads tall, smaller and more compact than the other cast.
MAIN POSE: a confident asymmetrical planted stance, one paw resting lightly on the side of an upright bamboo papermaking screen, other paw gesturing "leave it to me", head cheerfully tilted, tail counterbalancing; screen does not hide torso.
THREE HEAD STUDIES: confident wide grin; pinched concentration with cheeks slightly puffed; surprised splashed face then laughing, visibly distinct.
THREE ACTION SCENES: (1) leaning with bent knees lifting ONE coherent sheet of wet paper on a bamboo screen from a shallow vat, few simple water strokes; (2) stooping and squinting at paper fibers on the screen, earnest and funny; (3) getting a small splash on nose, shaking one paw and smiling, screen safely supported by vat. Grounded poses; no magical skill or extra companions. Compact separate props: bamboo screen and pulp stirring stick, drawn simply with purposeful ink marks.
EXACT CHINESE COPY: title "泡泡"; subtitle "水獭 · 抄纸钱灵"; short intro "爽快手稳，遇事先动手。\n纸要抄匀，道理也要讲明白。"; heading "表情差分"; heads labels "自信" "专注" "被溅到"; actions labels "抄纸" "看纤维" "溅一鼻子"; prop labels "竹帘" "搅浆棒"; tiny skill note "专长：抄纸加速". Spell name 泡泡 correctly.
